title: Learning Metrics and Usability Metrics
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting learning metrics and usability metrics to moderated usability test script with observation-to-revision trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Classify a metric as usability (operability) or learning (capability gain) by the construct it measures.
Pair each claim with a metric that has the validity to support it, never a proxy.
Read satisfaction as an attitude signal, not as evidence of learning or of effectiveness.
Combine completion, time, error, and outcome data into a picture no single number could give.
